units: Ez. XLII, 12) to balance, make corresponding.—Part. pass. הָגוּן (cmp. רָאוּי, חָזֵי) fit, worthy.
<cite ref="Chullin 133a:14">Ḥull. 133ᵃ</cite> <he>תלמיד שאינו ה׳</he> an unworthy student.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 5:4">Esth. R. to II, 4</cite> <he>מי ה׳ לדבר זה</he> who was well-fitted for this mission?; Midr. Sam. ch. XIII.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 80a:10">B. Kam. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נתכוונה אלא לה׳ לה</he> she had in her mind only such a one as would be worthy of her; a. fr.—Pl. <he>הֲגוּנִין</he>.

senses.gloss: , part. pass. <he>מְהוּגָּן</he> = <he>הָגוּן</he>; pl. <he>מְהוּגָּנִים</he>, <he>מְהוּגָּנִין</he>. B. Kam. l. c. <he>ב״א שאינן מ׳</he> unworthy people (not her equals). Ib. 16ᵇ <he>ב״א שאינן מ׳</he> unworthy recipients of charity.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 22a:10">Keth. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אנשים מ׳</he> worthy men (proposing to me).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 70a:8">Kidd. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>בנים שאינן מ׳</he> degenerate children; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00195"><he>הוּגָּן</he></cite>

senses.gloss: to be of the same weight. Y. Keth. I, 25ᵇ top טביריניות מַהֲגִינוֹת וכ׳ (not סב׳) the Tiberian Selaim are of the same weight as &c.
